title: Household Usage once Settled into a Larger Footing on Tailwise Autoship
content:
Once the household has settled into its larger usage, every charged unit counts in the household's usage of the item behind a second pet's own Autoship Everyday subscription under Tailwise Autoship (opened for an item the household already receives on another pet's Autoship).

## Did usage rise?

The usage rose when the average units per scheduled shipment charged on the existing Autoship in the last six months exceed the average units per scheduled shipment charged between six and twelve months ago. It did not rise when either period has no scheduled shipment.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

## Household usage when it rose

| Scheduled shipments charged in the last six months | Household usage |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | The units of all shipments charged in the last six months, ship-now shipments included, divided by 26 weeks |
| fewer than 3 | The units of all shipments charged in the last three months, ship-now shipments included, divided by 13 weeks |

When usage did not rise, the household usage is not re-measured on this footing.

## Worked cases (hypothetical existing Autoship)

- Average 2 units per scheduled shipment between six and twelve months ago, 3 in the last six months, 4 scheduled shipments in the last six months; all shipments of the last six months total 15 units including one ship-now of 3: 15 divided by 26, about 0.58 unit a week.
- Same rise with only 2 scheduled shipments in the last six months; all shipments of the last three months total 9 units: 9 divided by 13, about 0.69 unit a week.
